Arrival.title: Getting in
Arrival.subtitle: From the street to your apartment in just a few minutes.
Arrival.checkInText: If it's ready earlier, we'll message you.
Arrival.mapAlt: Aerial view of the building with the walking route from the street to the entrance
Arrival.step1Text: The entrance is on the inner side of the building, not on the street side.
Arrival.step2Text: 3rd floor — turn right out of the elevator, the door is right next to it. Name on the door: Surname.
Arrival.step3Text: Please let us know when you're in. We need your check-in time for the official guest registration (eVisitor).

photos.path3: The entrance is in the courtyard.
photos.path4: Use this door to enter the building.
photos.path5: Enter the access code on the keypad.
photos.apartment1: After entering the building, walk towards the elevator.
photos.apartment2: Take the elevator to the third floor.
photos.apartment3: When you exit the elevator, turn right. The apartment door is next to the elevator.
photos.apartment5: Look for the name "Surname" on the apartment door.
photos.apartment6: The lockbox is mounted on the wall next to the apartment door.

CheckOut.goodbyeText: Send us a message when you leave so we can start cleaning.

door.title: Lock the door
door.text: Make sure the apartment is locked.

key.title: Return the key
key.text: Back in the lockbox, then scramble the digits.

parking.title: Drop the parking card
parking.text: In the mailbox — only after you've driven out.

Coffee.title: Make a coffee
Coffee.subtitle: Dolce Gusto · swipe through 10 short steps.
Coffee.waterText: Push it fully in. Small air bubbles at the bottom mean it's seated — otherwise no water comes out.
Coffee.milkText: Use two capsules: milk first, wait for green, then coffee or chocolate.

power.title: Turn on the machine
power.text: Press the power button. The light will blink red while the machine heats up.

ready.title: Wait for the green light
ready.text: When the light turns green, the machine is ready to use.

holderOut.title: Remove the capsule holder
holderOut.text: Lift the top cover and pull out the capsule holder.

capsule.title: Insert a capsule
capsule.text: Place a coffee capsule inside the holder.

holderIn.title: Reinsert the holder
holderIn.text: Push the capsule holder back into the machine and close the top cover.

water.title: Select water level
water.text: Move the selector up or down to match the number of bars shown on the capsule.

cup.title: Place your cup
cup.text: Put your cup under the coffee outlet.

brew.title: Make your coffee
brew.text: Move the lever to the red side for hot drinks. The machine will stop automatically.

readyAgain.title: Wait for green again
readyAgain.text: Wait until the power button turns green before removing the capsule holder.

cleanUp.title: Remove the used capsule
cleanUp.text: Lift the top cover, remove the capsule holder and throw away the used capsule. Do not leave used capsules inside the machine.

Dishwasher.title: Run the dishwasher
Dishwasher.subtitle: One capsule, three buttons.
Dishwasher.step1Text: Put one capsule in the detergent compartment and close the lid. Capsules are under the sink.
Dishwasher.step3Text: Press PROGR. <button>2</button> until you reach the program you want, see the list below.
Dishwasher.step4Text: Press START <button>3</button>, then close the door.
Dishwasher.step5Text: Hold START <start>3</start> for a few seconds to reset, then press power <power>1</power> to switch off.
Dishwasher.manualText: Other programs · paper copy in the kitchen cabinet

photos.compartment1: Place one capsule in the detergent compartment.
photos.compartment2: Close the lid before starting the dishwasher.

Emergency.title: Need help?
Emergency.emergencyText: Police, ambulance and fire — English spoken.
Emergency.messageHostText: Broken appliance, locked out, leaks — via WhatsApp

pharmacy.name: Jadran Pharmacy
pharmacy.text: Open day and night, including weekends and public holidays. Prescription and non-prescription medication available.

hospital.name: Emergency Department
hospital.text: For urgent medical situations requiring immediate treatment at Zadar General Hospital.

clinic.name: Tourist Clinic
clinic.text: Medical care for tourists and visitors with non-emergency health concerns, including weekends and public holidays.

Essentials.title: Where is everything?
Essentials.subtitle: Tap an item to see a photo of exactly where it is.

ironingBoard.title: Ironing board
ironingBoard.text: Behind the kitchen door, next to the trash bin.

hairDryer.title: Hair dryer
hairDryer.text: In the bathroom, in the middle drawer under the sink.

capsules.title: Washing machine capsules
capsules.text: In the bathroom, in the first drawer under the sink.

iron.title: Iron
iron.text: In the hallway cabinet next to the bathroom, on the left side.

towels.title: Extra towels
towels.text: In the hallway cabinet next to the bathroom, on the right side.

firstAid.title: First aid kit
firstAid.text: Inside the TV stand, on the right side, behind the glass door.

Explore.title: Our Zadar picks
Explore.subtitle: Places we'd send our friends to.

kolovare.name: Kolovare Beach
kolovare.text: The most popular city beach with crystal-clear water, shaded areas and cafés nearby.

borik.name: Borik Beach
borik.text: Family-friendly beach with shallow water, nearby restaurants and plenty of amenities.

uskok.name: Uskok Beach
uskok.text: A lively beach in the Puntamika area, popular for swimming, sunbathing and beach bars.

butler.name: Butler Gourmet & Cocktails
butler.text: Modern restaurant and cocktail bar with a stylish atmosphere and creative dishes.

harbor.name: Harbor CookHouse
harbor.text: Popular waterfront restaurant known for excellent burgers, steaks and cocktails.

bruschetta.name: Bruschetta
bruschetta.text: One of Zadar’s best-known restaurants, serving Mediterranean cuisine by the sea.

fosa.name: Foša
fosa.text: Fine dining restaurant located beside the historic city walls and harbour.

kantuna.name: 4 Kantuna
kantuna.text: Traditional Dalmatian restaurant offering local dishes in the heart of the Old Town.

garden.name: The Garden Lounge
garden.text: The perfect place for sunset cocktails with panoramic sea views.

seaOrgan.name: Sea Organ
seaOrgan.text: A unique architectural installation that creates music using sea waves.

greetingSun.name: Greeting to the Sun
greetingSun.text: A solar-powered light installation best experienced at sunset.

donat.name: St. Donatus Church
donat.text: The symbol of Zadar and one of Croatia’s most important pre-Romanesque churches.

forum.name: Roman Forum
forum.text: The largest Roman forum on the eastern Adriatic coast.

peoplesSquare.name: People’s Square
peoplesSquare.text: The historic heart of Zadar surrounded by cafés and local life.

kalelarga.name: Kalelarga
kalelarga.text: Zadar’s most famous street and the centre of city life.

cathedral.name: St. Anastasia Cathedral
cathedral.text: The largest cathedral in Dalmatia with a bell tower offering city views.

landGate.name: Land Gate
landGate.text: The historic entrance to the Old Town and part of Zadar’s Venetian fortifications.

supernova.name: Supernova Zadar
supernova.text: The largest shopping centre in Zadar, with a supermarket, cafés, McDonald’s and many stores.

lidl.name: Lidl
lidl.text: Popular supermarket for groceries, drinks and everyday essentials.

kaufland.name: Kaufland
kaufland.text: Large supermarket offering groceries, household items and fresh produce.

cityGalleria.name: City Galleria
cityGalleria.text: Shopping centre with stores, cafés and a local market.

farmacia.name: Farmacia City Galleria
farmacia.text: For pain relief, vitamins, cosmetics, sunscreen and everyday health essentials. Prescription medication is not available.

HouseRules.title: House rules
HouseRules.subtitle: A few simple things that keep everyone happy.
HouseRules.timesNote: These times give us enough time to prepare the apartment for the next guests.
HouseRules.quietText: It's a residential building with permanent neighbours — noise carries in the hallway, stairs and elevator.
HouseRules.kidsNote: Travelling with kids? Please keep running and loud play out of the hallway and elevator.

smoking.title: No smoking inside
smoking.text: Smoking is fine on the terrace.

breaks.title: Tell us if something breaks
breaks.text: No stress — just let us know as soon as you can.

Parking.title: Parking
Parking.guestsOnlyText: Parking details are available to guests in the production version.

Tv.title: Watching TV
Tv.subtitle: Two remotes, two jobs. Here's which is which.
Tv.step1Text: Press power on the small remote.
Tv.step2Text: Pick an app on the home screen.
Tv.step3Text: Select the HDMI icon to open EON — live channels and the EON library.

Wifi.title: Get online
Wifi.subtitle: Copy the password and connect.
Wifi.cantConnectText: Restart the router, it's right behind the TV. Press the black button on the back to turn it off, wait 10 seconds, then press it again. Give it a couple of minutes to reconnect.

ThankYou.title: Thank you for staying with us
ThankYou.text: We hope you enjoyed Zadar and would love to welcome you back.
